name: orchard-release
description: Review Orchard deployment evidence before approving a rollout.

files.SKILL.md:
# Orchard release review

Use this skill when a rollout changes replicas or the recovery procedure.

Read references/checklist.md. Return the changed setting, source path and rollback condition. Ask for missing evidence before approval.
files.references/checklist.md:
# Evidence checklist

- Confirm the replica count from the deployment manifest.
- Confirm the recovery timestamp from the restore log.
- Quote the health check result and its observation time.
